messages:
sasha: Heads-up — planning a schema deploy tomorrow during the 00:30-01:30 UTC change window. It adds `user_profile.flags` (jsonb) + a short backfill. Main risk is an index build and an UPDATE spike. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: @sasha scheduled migration job `mig-1971-add-flags` for 1970-05-10T00:30:00Z. Canary: 2 pods, rollout: progressive.

matt: +1, we should pin the API service to v2.14.0 for the rollout so breaking flag reads are predictable.

julia: Can we do the backfill as chunked updates to avoid long table locks? Example: `UPDATE users SET flags = '{}' WHERE flags IS NULL LIMIT 10000;` with a pause.

kevin: We can do chunked writes but watch for replication lag. If lag > 30s, we should pause writes and fallback. I'll add a lag monitor.

sasha: Runbook sketch — will post minimal commands to run during the window. Fallback plan is to pin all traffic to the previous model/version and abort migration. Revert tag: `service@v2.13.9`.

sasha: ```
# preflight checks (run before 00:30)
SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE flags IS NULL;
pg_stat_replication_delay(); -- custom helper
CHECKSUM user_profiles;
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `service:v2.14.0` on cluster-prod-canary — 2/2 pods healthy. Logs: `canary: health ok`.

julia: Add a preflight smoke query for key endpoints that read flags: `GET /profile/:id?fields=flags` to ensure no 500s in canary.

ops-oncall: If we see sustained 5xx or latency > 2s on the smoke query during canary, we abort and pin to `v2.13.9`. Also prepare an escape-hatch script to toggle `flags_enabled=false` via feature flag.

kevin: I'll run a quick replica lag script every 60s and post to this thread: `replica-lag: 12s`. If it goes above 30s I will @ops-oncall.

sasha: Explicit rollback steps (short):
1) Abort migration job in UI / `job cancel mig-1971-add-flags`
2) Pin traffic to `service@v2.13.9` via infra rollout API
3) Run consistency check for partial updates and resume safe backfill later

julia: For the index build: prefer `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` and build on replica if possible. If replication lags too much, we skip index and re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: Canary finished: `canary: success` — metrics stable for 10m.

sasha: Thanks. Final checklist: preflight queries posted, canary ok, ops monitoring in place. I'll kick migration at 00:33 to avoid overlap with other teams. Anyone want to opt-out of the window?

dalia: I'm good. I'll be on-call for post-migration validation (data integrity quick-checks).

matt: LGTM. Please add the short release note: "Add user_profile.flags column (jsonb). Backfill chunked; index built concurrently. Rollback target v2.13.9."

sasha: Added to release notes and pinned the rollout time. Will paste live runbook in case we need it. :thumbsup:
